rawRetro.summary: Repair attempt 3 for issue 496 (内部资料只读问答助手). Fixed the seed module-resolution failure that blocked application startup, the composite-resource registration order that made stored grants invalid, a wildcard API middleware leak, a write read-back permission failure, a missing createdAt/updatedAt on writes, and a test-only CSRF trusted-origin gap. Also completed the assistant wiring: a named read-only employee (materials-desk) and a backend materials-lookup tool that authorizes the same composite resource the page uses, so the consultant's read is narrowed in SQL before a confidential record can reach an answer or citation. B00 is verified end-to-end against the compiled dist server, and the employee/tool registration plus the colleague-vs-supervisor data scope are covered by a new test. B01-B05 remain blocked because no independent business/AI test model is configured (llmServices=0).

blockers.title: Database seed imported a TypeScript source through a .js specifier
blockers.symptom: AppDatabaseTaskError: Database seeds failed for connection "main": Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from '.../database/main/seeds/202610010002_materials_demo.ts' (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
blockers.rootCause: Node 24 native TypeScript stripping executes the seed without rewriting relative .js specifiers to .ts, so an import that named a TypeScript-only file with a .js extension resolved to a file that does not exist.
blockers.resolution: Import the source with a .ts specifier in database/main/seeds/202610010002_materials_demo.ts and database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts. tsconfig.server.json enables allowImportingTsExtensions and rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, so the compiler emits .js specifiers into dist; verified in dist/database/main/seeds/.manifest.json and the compiled imports.

blockers.title: Composite resource registered after stored grants were scanned
blockers.symptom: Error: Authorization has invalid stored grants: - Permission set materials-colleague grants composite:materials.library.view, which no longer applies: Unknown composite resource action: materials.library.view.
blockers.rootCause: The application provider registered its composite resource in start(), but the authorization plugin provider's start() scans stored grants before the application's service providers start, so the grant named an action that was not yet registered.
blockers.resolution: Register the composite resource in MaterialsProvider.register() (server/providers/materials.ts), which runs before any provider starts, and guard it with container.has(authorizationToken) so an app assembled without the authorization plugin still boots.

blockers.title: Wildcard middleware in the materials contribution leaked into sibling API routes
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 'starts a fresh Default without example tables or APIs' expected 200 for GET /api/articles and received 401.
blockers.rootCause: router.use('*', authentication.required(), ...) mounted in one API contribution becomes /api/* on the parent router and intercepted every later API contribution, not just the paths the route owns.
blockers.resolution: Scope each guard to the two paths the route owns with router.use('/materials', guard) and router.use('/materials/*', guard), covering the collection and the item routes and nothing else.

blockers.title: Create and update failed a read-back permission check
blockers.symptom: A manage grant could write a material but the write then threw READ_FORBIDDEN while re-reading the row it had just touched.
blockers.rootCause: The Repository re-reads the written record under the same policy, and the materials write permission declared create/update/delete but no read fields.
blockers.resolution: Declare the read fields on the materialsWrite permission in server/materials-resources.ts, because reading a record you may manage is part of managing it.

blockers.title: Material insert failed a NOT NULL constraint on createdAt
blockers.symptom: SqliteError: insert into materials ... NOT NULL constraint failed: materials.created_at when the supervisor created a material.
blockers.rootCause: The collection declares createdAt and updatedAt NOT NULL without a database default, and @nocobase/db has no automatic timestamp behaviour, so a writer that omitted them inserted NULL.
blockers.resolution: The materials route sets createdAt/updatedAt on create and updatedAt on update, and the write permission lists those fields; the seed already supplied them. Mirrors how the notification-in-app plugin writes its own rows.

blockers.title: Cookie-authenticated writes were rejected as INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN in the isolated test server
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts expected 201 for a supervisor POST and received 403 {"code":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN"}.
blockers.rootCause: The isolated standalone test config set no app.publicOrigin, so better-auth's trusted origins were empty and checkCookieWriteOrigin rejected the write's Origin header.
blockers.resolution: The runtime test config fixture now writes app.publicOrigin and the write requests send a matching Origin header; the production standalone server trusts APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN the same way.

blockers.title: No independent business/AI model configured for the assistant criteria
blockers.symptom: Server reports llmServices=0; POST /api/ai/ai:listAllEnabledModels returns [], so B01–B05 cannot be exercised.
blockers.rootCause: The verification environment provides no independent business test model or LLM service credentials.
blockers.resolution: Implemented and verified without a model: server/materials-service.ts authorizes the materials.library composite for a hand-built actor identity and binds the returned policy with repository.withPolicy; server/ai/tools/materials-lookup.ts exposes it as a read-only tool, and server/ai/employees/materials-desk registers a named employee that cites results and refuses to answer without evidence. A new app-server test proves the colleague's tool reads only the two public materials while the supervisor reads all three. B00 is satisfied without a model: the assistant page shows an explicit not-configured notice and the materials page stays usable. B01-B05 stay blocked pending a configured model.

improvements.title: Resolve TypeScript sources with .ts specifiers in seeds and migrations
improvements.detail: Node's native TS stripping does not rewrite .js specifiers to .ts. Any seed or migration that imports an application-owned TypeScript module should use the .ts specifier, and the server tsconfig rewrites it to .js at build time.

improvements.title: Register composite resources before providers start
improvements.detail: Authorization scans stored grants in its provider start(), which runs before the application's service providers start. A composite resource must be registered in register()/boot() rather than start() or stored grants are reported invalid.

improvements.title: Never use router.use('*') in an API contribution
improvements.detail: A wildcard use() in one contribution becomes /api/* on the parent and intercepts sibling contributions. Scope middleware to the exact paths the route owns.

improvements.title: An out-of-band AI tool must authorize like the HTTP path
improvements.detail: A tool call has no request, so no authz middleware runs. Build the actor identity explicitly (principal plus authenticated:* plus resolved memberships), authorize the same composite resource the page uses, and bind the resulting database policy with repository.withPolicy - never hand a tool an unscoped Repository.

evaluation.summary: 围绕 4 个能力单元（AI 员工运行时与对话前端、授权/复合资源、数据库与种子、应用服务器路由）完成只读评审。框架在员工/工具注册、上下文隔离、复合资源与行级策略强制、生命周期与路由分区上提供了可直接组合的能力，并随包提供带就绪门禁的对话前端。主要缺陷集中在文档/Skill：种子 .js 说明符与 .ts 文字自相矛盾、顶层通配中间件示例与另一份 Skill 的泄漏警告冲突、写权限回读字段与非空时间戳在端到端流程中说明不足。验收冻结结果为 B00 通过、B01–B05 因无测试模型 blocked、B06 not_run。

modules.scope: 评审 @nocobase/ai-employee 与 @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee 如何承载“AI 员工/工具注册、上下文隔离、对话就绪状态与引用输出”。对应 material-desk 助手能力的框架部分，不含业务提示词与业务资料读取逻辑。
modules.limitations: 未在缺少业务测试模型的前提下运行真实问答，故就绪门禁与引用链的运行时表现只依据源码、指引与验收报告推断；工具调用的端到端可靠性未实测。

requirementFit.reason: 框架直接提供员工/工具注册、请求级上下文隔离与前端就绪门禁，业务只需定义技能与资料读取；未配置模型时的明确状态由框架托管，贴合“资料助手 + 未配置态”的核心需求。

usability.reason: Registry 版 nocobase-ai 前端与 useAI() 就绪信号降低接入成本，chat-surfaces 给出三类就绪信号与降级展示；但对话状态、引用渲染仍需业务自行组装，指引细节较分散。

agentFriendliness.reason: AgentContext 显式暴露 actor/deps 并禁止环境句柄，工具依赖以令牌声明、由容器注入，Agent 能按类型与文档稳定编写工具；注册顺序固定为 tools→skills→employees，扩展点清晰。

design.reason: 上下文隔离（每工具独立 deps）、技能与员工分层注册、就绪状态四信号拆分，边界清楚、可组合，未见明显的全局可变状态泄漏。

reliability.reason: 工具上下文解析在缺少 base/容器或令牌不可解析时给出带工具名的显式错误；Registry Provider 以 configured!==false 判定模型可用性，逻辑稳健。未验证真实模型调用路径。

modules.name: 授权与复合资源（行级范围）
modules.scope: 评审 @nocobase/authorization 与 @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization 组合出的复合资源、记录访问解析、数据权限组合与存储授权校验，以及这些能力的指引质量。对应“保密资料 C 仅主管可见”的授权框架部分。
modules.limitations: 未实测生产/开发两种 NODE_ENV 下 stored grants 校验的完整行为；记录范围解析器在复杂 join/多集合场景下的性能未测量。

requirementFit.reason: 复合资源把业务动作组合到集合授权，记录访问解析器与数据权限（DAC）在仓储层强制，能直接表达“行级存在性 + 字段可见性”，满足保密行的需求。

usability.reason: defineCompositeResource/defineRecordAccess 的 builder API 类型友好，但显式要求集合、范围、放置、权限集多处同步注册，指引分散，漏一步即出现运行时错误。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引存在冲突：runtime-api 与 repository-routes 展示 router.use('*'…) 的写法，而 server-routes 警告顶层通配中间件会泄漏；种子示例又给出指向 .ts 文件的 .js 说明符，Agent 容易被误导产生启动/401 故障。

design.reason: 授权定义与执行分离：复合资源只描述授权，审计与 stored grants 在 provider.start() 统一校验；数据库策略按动作独立组合，职责边界清楚。

reliability.reason: composeDatabasePolicies 对未授予动作严格置 false 并在违规读取时抛 READ_FORBIDDEN；stored grants 在开发环境抛错、生产环境告警，行为可预期。

findings.title: 授权 Skill 的种子示例用 .js 说明符导入 .ts 文件，与同段文字自相矛盾并导致安装种子失败
findings.detail: code-and-seeds.md 的示例写 import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js'，而同一段结尾说明该文件是 database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts。迁移/种子由 task-loader 以原生 import 加载，__rewriteRelativeImportExtension 只把源码中的 .ts/.tsx 说明符改写为 .js，并不存在把 .js 说明符解析回 .ts 的机制，因此照抄示例会在安装时抛 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND。
findings.claimed: 指引把 .js 说明符作为可复制的种子写法，并同时称目标文件是 .ts。
findings.observed: 迁移/种子任务加载器（task-loader.js）仅改写 .ts→.js，无反向解析；应用最初照抄该示例，安装报 “Cannot find module .../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js”，改为 .ts 后才通过。
findings.impact: Agent 按官方示例生成的安装种子在 Node 原生 TS 运行时会直接启动失败，且错误信息指向示例本身，排查成本高。
findings.suggestedChange: 把示例统一改为 .ts 说明符（与第 97 行文字一致），并补一句说明源码用 .ts、构建时会被 TypeScript 改写为 .js。

diagnosis.trigger: 按 code-and-seeds.md 第 69 行示例编写安装种子，导入同一 Skill 文档称为 .ts 的 seed-data 文件
diagnosis.expected: 种子能被安装流程加载并执行
diagnosis.actual: 原生 import 解析 .js 失败，安装中断于 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
diagnosis.workaround: 把相对导入说明符改成 .ts，构建阶段由 TS 改回 .js
diagnosis.acceptance: 安装种子在无 dist 的情况下成功执行，且构建产物仍使用 .js 说明符

findings.title: 授权 Skill 示例使用顶层 router.use('*') 与另一份 Skill 的泄漏警告冲突，实测污染其他 API 路由
findings.detail: runtime-api.md 展示 router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware())，repository-routes.md 第 168 行也称 "*" 在“孤立、自有”的路由器中是合适的；但 server-routes.md 明确警告顶层通配中间件会泄漏到之后挂载的贡献路由。当业务路由器被挂到 /api 时，use('*') 实际作用于 /api/*，导致无关路由（如 /api/articles）也需要该认证而返回 401。
findings.claimed: 指引把 router.use('*') 当作服务端强制认证/授权的标准写法，并暗示在自有路由器中安全。
findings.observed: server-routes.md 警告顶层 router.use('*') 会泄漏到后续挂载的贡献；应用照抄后 GET /api/articles 返回 401，改为 /materials 前缀后才恢复。
findings.impact: Agent 采用官方示例即可让整个 /api 命名空间被错误拦截，影响面超出业务模块，且与另一份 Skill 的明确警告相互矛盾。
findings.suggestedChange: 把 runtime-api.md 与 repository-routes.md 的示例统一为显式前缀或挂载在自有前缀下的独立子路由器，并交叉引用 server-routes.md 的“Scope middleware to paths you own”。

diagnosis.trigger: 按 runtime-api.md 第 117 行在业务 API 路由器上安装 router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware())
diagnosis.expected: 只有业务路径需要认证，其他 /api 贡献保持原有可访问性
diagnosis.actual: 通配中间件作用于整个 /api 前缀，/api/articles 返回 401
diagnosis.workaround: 把中间件限定到 /materials 与 /materials/*
diagnosis.acceptance: 业务路径需要认证，其余 /api 路由不受影响，且指引示例不再使用顶层通配

findings.title: 写权限未声明 read 字段会在回读时抛 READ_FORBIDDEN，指引未在端到端流程中强调
findings.detail: composeDatabasePolicies 以 read:false 为初值，只对显式授予的动作置 true；repository.createOne 写入后以绑定读策略回读返回字段。因此一个只有 create/update 而无 read 字段的权限会在写入成功前后抛 READ_FORBIDDEN。repository-routes.md 有“read plus update”提示，但 runtime-api.md 的“Enforce the operation on the server”流程只提醒包含服务端写入字段，未说明写权限必须同时声明读字段。
findings.impact: Agent 按自定义端点流程配置写权限时，create/update 会以难以定位的 READ_FORBIDDEN 失败，虽然数据本身并未越权。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 runtime-api.md 的动作/字段说明处补充：create/update 权限无法读取自身结果时会因策略回读失败，需同时声明所需 read 字段。

diagnosis.trigger: 为写权限仅声明 create/update 字段并执行 createOne/updateOne
diagnosis.expected: 写入成功并返回所声明的返回字段
diagnosis.actual: 写后回读触发 READ_FORBIDDEN，请求失败
diagnosis.workaround: 在写权限中补充 .read([...]) 所需字段
diagnosis.acceptance: 带写权限的角色可成功创建/更新并按策略回读

findings.title: 数据库 Skill 的迁移示例声明非空 createdAt 却在 createOne 示例中省略该字段
findings.detail: nocobase-db SKILL 的迁移示例使用 collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false }) 且无默认值，而同一 Skill 的 createOne 示例只写 name/owner。db 层没有全局审计时间戳自动填充：只有 SeedContext.repository 文档承诺处理时间戳，普通 repository 写入需要调用方提供。照抄两段示例会得到 NOT NULL constraint failed: createdAt。
findings.impact: Agent 会写出在真实插入时因非空时间列无默认值而失败的表与种子/写入代码，违反直观的约定优于配置预期。
findings.suggestedChange: 在迁移与写示例处说明审计时间列的来源：要么在迁移中给出默认值，要么在写入时显式传入，并明确普通 repository 不做自动时间戳填充。

diagnosis.trigger: 按 SKILL 迁移示例建立非空 createdAt 列，并按 createOne 示例不传时间戳
diagnosis.expected: 插入成功或文档明确要求显式时间戳
diagnosis.workaround: 为列加默认值或在 values 中传入 createdAt/updatedAt
diagnosis.acceptance: 示例可直接运行，且文档说明时间戳填充范围

findings.title: 框架随包提供 nocobase-ai 对话前端与多信号就绪门禁
findings.detail: app-plugin-ai-employee 的 registry/nocobase-ai 是可直接安装的前端对话表面，Provider 暴露 configurationStatus/configurationError/modelConfigurationError/hasEnabledModels 四个独立信号，并用 UNCONFIGURED_MODEL 占位；chat-surfaces.md 的 readiness gate 说明如何据此降级。应用无需手写对话 UI 即获得“未配置模型”的明确状态。
findings.impact: 显著降低资料助手前端的实现与验收成本，并让“未配置”成为框架级的一等状态而非业务补丁。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该 Registry 表面的公开契约稳定，并在 Skill 中补充多信号优先级的判定顺序示例。

findings.title: AI 工具上下文隔离与授权策略在数据层强制的组合
findings.detail: ai-employee 为每个工具解析其声明的依赖并返回独立上下文，工具无法访问未声明的容器内容；authorization 的复合资源/记录范围与 db 的策略回读共同保证行级可见性在仓储层生效，而不是依赖前端过滤。两者结合使“资料助手只能看到有权资料”具备可审计的实现基础。
findings.impact: 降低了提示词或前端疏漏导致越权读取保密资料的风险，并为引用回链提供可信的可见性边界。
findings.suggestedChange: 继续在 Skill 中以端到端示例展示工具 actor 与行级策略的配合，减少 Agent 自行拼接的出错空间。

evidence.observation: ai-employee 定义 AgentContext：工具运行上下文显式携带 deps/actor/state/runtime，说明工具不依赖环境中的数据库或容器句柄，只能读取声明注入的依赖与当前 actor。
createToolContext 按工具声明的 dependencies 令牌逐个从容器解析，并返回该工具专属的 { ...base, deps }；工具之间互相看不到对方的依赖，实现请求级上下文隔离。
AIResourceRegistrar.registerAIResources 以 tools → skills → employees 的固定顺序注册，loadSkills 扫描 **/SKILL.md，提供 AI 员工能力的稳定扩展点。
nocobase-ai 前端 Provider 暴露 configurationStatus/configurationError/modelConfigurationError/hasEnabledModels 四个独立就绪信号，配合第 38 行 UNCONFIGURED_MODEL 占位提供“未配置模型”状态。

chat-surfaces.md 的“The readiness gate”给出 useAI() 的 configurationStatus/configurationError/modelConfigurationError/hasEnabledModels 四信号读取与逐项降级展示示例（含“No AI employees are available”），并将聊天子树包在 NocoBaseAIRootProvider 下。
composite.js 提供复合资源构建器：action.grant 绑定集合权限与命名 dataScope，并在 build 时深拷贝；复合资源把“业务动作 → 集合授权”组合成可复用的授权定义。
defineRecordAccess 构造带 resolver 与 collections 的记录访问定义，并校验 key/collections/resolver；行级范围通过解析器在查询时求值。
composeDatabasePolicies 以 {read:false,create:false,update:false,delete:false} 为初值，仅对已授予动作置 true；未显式授予 read 的写权限得到的读策略仍为 false。
AuthorizationProvider.boot 只绑定实时主题，真正的资源放置与 stored grants 校验在 start() 中进行，注释说明“Every provider has booted, so every plugin has placed its resources”，即注册必须在 boot 阶段完成。
runtime-api.md 说明集合/复合资源“In the owning provider's boot method”注册，并在同页示例中使用 router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware()) 作为服务端强制授权写法。
code-and-seeds.md 的种子示例 import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js'（第 69 行）指向一个 .ts 文件，而同一段结尾（第 97 行）又称该文件为 database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts，存在自相矛盾的模块扩展名。
repository-routes.md 的示例声明 view 用 read 字段、edit 用“read plus update”字段，是文档中少数提示写权限需同时声明 read 字段的地方。
policy/enforce.js 在执行读取校验时对不允许的动作抛出 READ_FORBIDDEN 错误，说明策略在仓储层强制而非仅靠路由。
repository.createOne 在写入后以 validateSelect(..., this.readContext(collection)) 回读返回字段，因此写入成功与否受绑定的读策略约束。
task-loader.js 顶部 __rewriteRelativeImportExtension 仅把源文件里的 .ts/.tsx 说明符改写为 .js，DEFAULT_TASK_EXTENSIONS 亦仅列出迁移/种子可发现的扩展名；并无把 .js 说明符反向解析到 .ts 源码的机制。
SeedContext 文档称安装数据通过 repository 以集合字段写入，“field encoding and timestamps handled for the dialect rather than by each seed”，此时间戳承诺仅针对 seed repository 通道。
nocobase-db SKILL 的迁移示例 collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false }) 未给默认值，即数据库列本身不会自动填充创建时间。
同一 SKILL 的 createOne 示例仅写 name/owner，未写 createdAt/updatedAt，文档未说明这些非空时间戳由谁补齐。
Application.startServiceProviders 固定启动顺序：validateConfig → registerProviders → registerLocales → bootAll → registerRoutes → startAll → readyAll，保证 providers 在路由注册前完成 boot。
registerRoutes 先注册 httpMiddleware，再对每个定义调用 createRouter 并按 scope 把路由器挂到 /api 或 /，且启动后路由不可再变更。
defineApiRoutes 与 defineRootRoutes 以 scope=api/root 冻结路由定义，应用服务器据此把业务 API 与根路由分区挂载。
server-routes.md 明确警告“A router.use('*', ...) on the top-level router leaks into contributions mounted later”，并把中间件限定到自有路径或独立子路由器。

Keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and its static policies. For business authorization, follow the installed authorization Skill’s `references/repository-routes.md`: `authz.database.authorizeRepository({ repository, resource, actions })` binds Repository methods to typed business actions and narrows the existing policy through middleware. Authenticate first and cover every action of the protected exposure. Use the shortcut when one Repository operation and one data scope complete the action with standard input/output; independent type/length validation can remain middleware. Persisted-state checks, side effects, multiple scopes and enriched responses require custom handlers: project title/notes editing fits the shortcut, while draft quote editing, quote submission and order delivery do not. One resource can use both styles for different actions. Do not substitute collection-aggregated grants for a business-action decision.

Static endpoint policies only narrow user grants. Read/write relation capabilities must be explicitly granted; a relation in the static shape does not create permission. Use the authorization Skill's `references/business-module.md` for the full workflow and `references/fluent-registration.md` for field/relation declarations. The installable authorization example demonstrates quote submission and delivery responsibilities.

## Enforcement and limits

- Mount the middleware on every action of the named exposure. Using `'*'` is appropriate inside an isolated, owned router: the middleware ignores other repository names. A method of its repository with no mapping is denied, including methods added to the generated route later.
- The middleware reuses the request's existing authorization context or initializes one. Authentication is still the owning route's responsibility.
- Each bound action must declare exactly one data scope, compose grants on that collection only and contain the mapped CRUD operation. Multi-collection or same-collection multi-scope actions are rejected at integration time. Resource registration must precede router creation.
- One composite can be bound to several Repository exposures through separate middleware instances. Each mapping is checked at the action level. An exposure's actual collection and database connection must match the request constraint; this adapter currently supports the default connection only.
- Keep actions requiring workflow state, cross-record relationships, or side effects in custom handlers. Single-scope authorization does not prove that an operation needs no business validation. Quote editing/submission and delivery remain custom in the sales workflow.
